decision.summary: A sharp, multi-sample downward offset in U begins at index 606 (coincident with candidate jump at 606), persists through index 614, and remains unrecovered within the allowed context [570,650]. E and N show transient co-movements but lack a matching step or return. The absence of an opposing return within the window prevents confirmation of a temporary offset; status is uncertain.

intervals.observation: U-component drops sharply from ~-2.7 to ~-10.3 between indices 605–606 (ΔU ≈ -7.6 MAD), sustained near -10 to -11 through index 614; E and N show correlated transients but no matching step. No opposing return observed within allowed context (up to 650); recovery is absent or delayed beyond window. Status: uncertain due to unobserved return.
